description: Trigger a background Gmail scan to discover and process receipt emails from the last ~60 days (default). Runs asynchronously — returns immediately, user gets an email summary when done. Like clicking "Find Receipts in Gmail" in the UI. For whole PAST YEARS (e.g. 2023, or 2020-2022) use scan_gmail_years instead; to check a scan's progress use get_scan_status.

accountEmail.description: Optional: which Gmail account to scan

lookbackDays.description: How many days back to scan (default 60, max depends on subscription)

startDate.description: Optional: explicit start date (YYYY-MM-DD) instead of lookbackDays

name: scan_gmail
